# anecdotes_role (Data Source)

Looks up an existing role (built-in or custom) by its `role_id` (key) — useful for referencing a base role's key in `anecdotes_role`'s `extends`, or discovering valid `permissions` values, without hardcoding them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_role" "viewer" {
  role_id = "viewer_role"
}

output "viewer_permissions" {
  value = data.anecdotes_role.viewer.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The role's key (e.g. "viewer_role", or a custom role's server-generated key).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the role.
- `extends` (List of String) Base role keys this role inherits permissions from.
- `full_access_frameworks` (List of String) Framework IDs this role has full access to, or null when unscoped.
- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) The role's live, resolved permission set.
